Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the “pro soccer organization headquartered in Atlanta” as the team Atlanta United FC (a franchise) rather than recognizing the organizational/league context. This misinterpretation led to faulty synthesis later, culminating in providing multiple franchises (NYCFC and NY Red Bulls) instead of the single correct franchise, New York City FC.
